name: trajectory-lens
description: AI-assisted Antigravity plugin re-implemented based on DSH official model trajectory visualization features: turn/step ledger, parallel execution DAG, subagent span waterfall, token & prompt-cache analytics, session compare, plain-language guide, and standalone HTML/Markdown export (Official Safe Mode, zero proxy).
suggestedPrompts: 打开 Trajectory Lens 侧边栏，可视化分析当前会话的模型运作轨迹与耗时瓶颈
总结当前会话的轮次、工具调用分布、Prompt Cache 命中率与异常重试步骤
将当前会话的完整运作轨迹导出为可离线回放的独立 HTML 报告
author: Apollyonin (AI-assisted re-implementation for Antigravity)
